# Copilot Instructions for SpaceScan

<!-- Use this file to provide workspace-specific custom instructions to Copilot. For more details, visit https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/copilot/copilot-customization#_use-a-githubcopilotinstructionsmd-file -->

This is a Python-based disk space analyzer project called SpaceScan. The project efficiently traverses directory structures and reports folder sizes in descending order.

## Project Guidelines:
- Focus on performance and memory efficiency when traversing large directory structures
- Use threading or async operations for better performance when scanning multiple directories
- Implement proper error handling for permission denied and inaccessible directories
- Follow Python best practices and PEP 8 style guidelines
- Use appropriate data structures for sorting and displaying results
- Provide clear command-line interface and user feedback during scanning operations
